title: Diophantine Approximation by Lagrangian Frames in Symplectic Lattices
summary: Classical Diophantine approximation searches for a short integral vector. In higher rank, one may retain either the rational subspace spanned by several such vectors or the integral frame itself. We study the latter problem for primitive Lagrangian frames $(Q,P) \in \mathrm{Mat}_{d \times 2d}(\mathbb{Z})$ and symmetric matrices.
